wallet.subtitle: Cashback from nights you've been to, refunds, and money from tickets you've resold. Spend it at checkout or withdraw it to your bank.

wallet.earnedNote: Cashback and resale, across 6 nights out.

tickets.title: My tickets
tickets.subtitle: Everything you've booked, in one place. Your QR codes work offline in the app.

ticket.refundPolicyBefore: Free cancellation until {{date}}. After that, transfer the seat or

rules.arriveBody: Security screening takes around 20 minutes at peak.
rules.cashlessBody: Card and Apple Pay only at all stalls inside the park.

gift.title: Send this ticket to a friend.
gift.subtitle: They'll get it instantly and it becomes theirs the moment they claim it — their own name, their own QR code.
gift.notePlaceholder: Happy birthday! See you at the gate at 19:30
gift.howTitle: Before you send — how this works
gift.howClaimBefore: Once they claim it, the ticket is theirs —
gift.howDeadlineAfter: to claim. Unclaimed, it comes straight back to you, still valid.
gift.howQr: Your old QR code stops working the moment the transfer completes.
gift.whyScreenshotBody: A screenshot can be copied and refused at the gate. Sending it through MyTicket makes the transfer official — one valid code, in their name.
gift.errorRecipient: Enter an email or phone number
gift.errorOrder: This order is not ready to gift yet — open it from My tickets after purchase

claim.title: Someone sent you a ticket.
claim.subtitle: Enter the claim token from your gift email or SMS. Once claimed, the ticket and QR are yours.
claim.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the token from your gift message
claim.success: Gift claimed — find it in My tickets
claim.missingToken: Enter the claim token from your gift message

resell.title: Let someone else take your seat.
resell.subtitle: Your ticket goes up on the MyTicket auction. Buyers bid or buy instantly, the transfer is handled for you, and the money lands in your wallet.

refund.title: Can't make it? Get your money back.
refund.subtitle: You're inside the free cancellation window. The refund goes to your MyTicket wallet, where you can spend it or withdraw it to your bank.

saved.waitlistsEmptyBody: When you join a sold-out waitlist, it will appear in this tab.

reviews.title: Your reviews
reviews.subtitle: The nights you've been to and what you said about them. Reviews come only from people who were really there — that's why yours matter.

reviews.writtenEmptyBody: When you post a score, it will show up here so you can come back to it.
reviews.placeholder: What stood out — entry, sound, seats, the night itself.
reviews.hint: Tap the stars to start — a score is all that's required, words are up to you. You can change anything for 30 days after posting.

right.title: Something wasn't right
right.body: A complaint about an organizer, a venue, safety, or how you were treated.

support.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Paid twice for the same order
support.detailsPlaceholder: The more detail, the faster we can help — what you did, what you expected, what happened instead.
support.replySla: We usually reply within one working day.
support.success: Sent to support — continue in chat
support.keepBody: You're chatting without signing in, so this chat disappears when you close it. Sign in to keep the history, or turn it into a tracked case you can follow.
support.keepSignIn: Sign in — you'll come right back
support.hours: Support hours: 9:00–01:00 AST, every day. Outside these hours, leave a message — we reply first thing.
